heading: About Me
biography: I am a Full‑Stack Web Developer blending civil‑engineering rigor with modern web technologies. After earning a B.Sc. in Civil Engineering (UAP), I ventured into digital marketing as an Affiliate Marketer & SEO specialist in 2015, gaining deep insights into search performance and user intent.

In 2020, I completed an intensive program with Programming Hero covering JavaScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, and MongoDB, which solidified my front‑end expertise. In 2022, I further expanded my skill set by completing a PHP & Laravel course at BITM, adding robust back‑end capabilities.
As co‑founder of iLabs360 and Shopnoneer, I translate this multidisciplinary knowledge into clean, performant, and SEO‑friendly web applications that solve real‑world problems.
careerGoals: To design and implement robust, performant web applications that deliver measurable value, while continually expanding my technical depth across modern software engineering stacks.
